It provided new guidance on risk-weighted assets of ~£210B as of Jan. 1, 2027. That compares with the Visible Alpha estimate of £206B at the end of 2026.
Q3 total income of £4.64B, in line with the Visible Alpha estimate, rose 3.0% Q/Q and 7.1% Y/Y. Excluding notable items, total income was £4.59B, up 3.1% Q/Q and 10% Y/Y.
Q3 net interest income of £3.56B, vs. the Visible Alpha consensus of £3.61B, increased 1.8% from Q2 and 8.9% from Q3 2025.
Noninterest income of £1.08B, exceeding the £1.03B Visible Alpha estimate, climbed 7.2% Q/Q and 1.6% Y/Y.
Operating expenses of £2.14B, lower than the Visible Alpha estimate of £2.21B, grew 2.8% Q/Q and 7.1% Y/Y.
Return on tangible equity improved to 21.6% from 21.0% in Q2 and declined from 22.3% in last year's Q3.
"We continued to simplify the business and maintained strong credit resilience across the loan portfolio," said Chief Financial Officer Katie Murray.
